tools.name: crm_delete-v3-objects-contacts-contact-id-archive
tools.description: Delete a contact by ID. Deleted contacts can be restored within 90 days of deletion. Required: contactId. Destructive.

params.name: contactId
params.description: Contact id

tools.name: crm_get-v3-objects-contacts-contact-id-get-by-id
tools.description: Retrieve a contact by its ID (`contactId`) or by a unique property (`idProperty`). You can specify what is returned using the `properties` query parameter. Required: contactId. Optional: archived (default: false), associations, idProperty (plus 2 more). Returns the SimplePublicObjectWithAssociations.

params.name: contactId
params.description: Contact id

params.name: archived
params.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

params.name: associations
params.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

params.name: idProperty
params.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

params.name: properties
params.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

params.name: propertiesWithHistory
params.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

tools.name: crm_get-v3-objects-contacts-get-page
tools.description: Retrieve all contacts, using query parameters to specify the information that gets returned. Optional: after, archived (default: false), associations (plus 3 more). Returns the CollectionResponseSimplePublicObjectWithAssociationsForwardPaging.

params.name: after
params.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

params.name: archived
params.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

params.name: associations
params.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

params.name: properties
params.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

params.name: propertiesWithHistory
params.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

tools.name: crm_patch-v3-objects-contacts-contact-id-update
tools.description: Update an existing contact, identified by ID or email/unique property value. To identify a contact by ID, include the ID in the request URL path. To identify a contact by their email or other unique property, include the email/property value in the request URL path, and add the `idProperty` query parameter (`/crm/v3/objects/contacts/jon@website.com?idProperty=email`). Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will result in an error. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string. Required: contactId, properties. Optional: idProperty. Returns the updated SimplePublicObject.

params.name: contactId
params.description: Contact id

params.name: idProperty
params.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

params.name: properties
params.description: Key value pairs representing the properties of the object.
